text:
From business idea to working application

Because the platform is unidentified, this is a platform-neutral workflow; the exact automation and artifacts available in this workspace cannot be verified.

Stages and generated outputs
flowchart TB
  S1[1. Discover and frame the idea] --> O1[Output: problem statement, goals, stakeholders, scope]
  O1 --> S2[2. Define requirements]
  S2 --> O2[Output: user stories, process rules, acceptance criteria, data and security needs]
  O2 --> S3[3. Design the solution]
  S3 --> O3[Output: architecture, data model, workflows, interfaces, UX prototypes]
  O3 --> S4[4. Generate or configure the application]
  S4 --> O4[Output: source code or low-code configuration, screens, services, schemas, tests]
  O4 --> S5[5. Connect dependencies]
  S5 --> O5[Output: API integrations, identity settings, secrets, environment configuration]
  O5 --> S6[6. Build and validate]
  S6 --> O6[Output: versioned deployable artifact, test results, defect records]
  O6 --> S7[7. Review and release]
  S7 --> O7[Output: approved release, deployment package, release notes, audit evidence]
  O7 --> S8[8. Deploy and operate]
  S8 --> O8[Output: working application, runtime configuration, logs, metrics, support records]
  O8 --> S9[9. Learn and enhance]
  S9 --> O9[Output: feedback, usage insights, prioritized improvements, new requirements]
  O9 --> S2
limitations: The platform name, workflow documentation, and workspace capability inventory were not supplied, so platform-specific stages and currently available generators cannot be confirmed.
